panels.title: GPU Usage History
panels.description: One row per full GPU UUID, labeled Node/Model/UUID8 and sorted ascending. Metadata uses the latest observation in the selected range. Blocks show namespaces; Pod changes within a namespace remain continuous. Namespace colors are automatic and may change when the selected namespace set changes. Unallocated intervals are transparent; unknown intervals are gray; both have blank labels. Purple indicates multiple namespaces sharing a GPU. Boundaries are sampled and become coarser over longer ranges. Available history depends on Prometheus retention.

targets.expression:
WITH states AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT occupant FROM C
), namespaces AS (
  SELECT occupant AS namespace FROM states
  WHERE occupant NOT IN ('Unallocated', 'Unknown', 'Shared namespaces')
), namespace_colors AS (
  SELECT namespace,
    CONCAT('hsl(', CAST(MOD((DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY namespace) - 1) * 137.508, 360) AS CHAR), ',65%,60%)') AS color
  FROM namespaces
)
SELECT states.occupant,
  CASE WHEN states.occupant IN ('Unallocated', 'Unknown') THEN '' ELSE states.occupant END AS text,
  CASE
    WHEN states.occupant = 'Unallocated' THEN '#00000000'
    WHEN states.occupant = 'Unknown' THEN '#808080'
    WHEN states.occupant = 'Shared namespaces' THEN '#B877D9'
    ELSE namespace_colors.color
  END AS color
FROM states
LEFT JOIN namespace_colors ON namespace_colors.namespace = states.occupant
ORDER BY states.occupant

panels.title: Namespace Ranking · A100 80GB Equivalent Hours
panels.description: Allocated GPU hours × installed VRAM / 80GB, summed by namespace over the selected time range. A 40GB GPU allocated for 2 hours equals 1 A100 80GB hour. This is VRAM-based accounting, not compute-performance equivalence. Allocation is counted even at 0% utilization; multiple Pods in one namespace are deduplicated, and cross-namespace sharing splits one GPU equally. Sampling interval: ${accounting_step_seconds} seconds. Telemetry gaps are excluded.

targets.expression:
WITH totals AS (
  SELECT A.exported_namespace AS namespace,
    SUM(A.__value__) AS gpu_hours,
    SUM(CASE WHEN C.__value__ IS NOT NULL THEN A.__value__ * C.__value__ / 80.0 ELSE 0 END) AS a100_hours,
    SUM(CASE WHEN C.__value__ IS NULL THEN A.__value__ ELSE 0 END) AS unrated_hours
  FROM A LEFT JOIN C ON A.UUID = C.UUID
  GROUP BY A.exported_namespace
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN unrated_hours > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, a100_hours DESC, namespace) AS rank_number
  FROM totals
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN unrated_hours > 0 THEN NULL ELSE rank_number END AS `Rank`,
  namespace AS Namespace,
  CASE WHEN unrated_hours > 0 THEN NULL ELSE a100_hours END AS a100_hours,
  gpu_hours
FROM ranked
ORDER BY CASE WHEN unrated_hours > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, a100_hours DESC, namespace
